def fetch_all_contacts(relationship, page_limit=20):
    allc=[]
    i=0
    while True:
        page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, relationship=relationship, page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        allc.extend(page)
        if len(page) < page_limit:
            break
        i += 1
    return allc

        page_index=i,
        page_limit=page_limit
    )

    if not page:
        break
    all_pending.extend(page)

allowed_emails_set = allowed_emails
matching = []
matching_ids = []
for pr in all_pending:
    sender_email = pr.get('sender', {}).get('email')
    if sender_email and sender_email in allowed_emails_set:
        matching.append(pr)
        matching_ids.append(pr.get('payment_request_id'))

results = []
for pr_id in matching_ids:
    res = apis.venmo.approve_payment_request(access_token=venmo_token, payment_request_id=pr_id)
    results.append((pr_id, res))
    print('approved', pr_id, '=>', res)

# Summarize failures if any

for pr_id, res in results:
